final: WITH event_metrics AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status) SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS average_overspend_rate, AVG(avg_remaining) / (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM event_metrics) AS average_remaining_divided_by_overall_event_average FROM event_metrics GROUP BY status
